envelope.action_line: Ask for a metric by id; unavailable ones explain what data is missing.

headline.sentence: 18 catalogue metrics are defined for Phase 1; 7 cannot be reported yet and say why.

envelope.precision_line: About 1 in 5 findings are wrong or contested (engine precision; the catalogue has no family-specific figure).

sources: metric catalogue (module definitions; no database read)

caveats: The score is an encounter proxy, not a clinician scorecard.
Notes where PDQI-9 was not assessed score 0 on note quality, which raises the index, so full NQI is shown over assessed notes only.
metrics.definition: Mean of the stored note_quality_index over notes where PDQI-9 was assessed (scorecard recorded and note_quality weight > 0); coverage = assessed / canonical notes; greyed under 50% coverage.
metrics.label: Mean OPD NQI (PDQI-assessed notes only)

caveats: The score is an encounter proxy, not a clinician scorecard.
Notes where PDQI-9 was not assessed score 0 on note quality, which raises the index, so full NQI is shown over assessed notes only.
metrics.definition: Share of PDQI-assessed notes with raw band A, A-B, and C-E (A>=85, B>=70, C>=55, D>=40, E<40). Value = share in A-B.
metrics.label: NQI band mix (raw band)

caveats: Domain scores are assumed to be on the same 0-100 scale as the NQI.
metrics.definition: Prescribing-safety and appropriateness domain scores, equally weighted and reweighted to 100 (documentation, patient-centredness and PDQI-9 excluded); over all canonical notes.
metrics.label: Clinical NQI

metrics.definition: Mean completeness_pct over canonical notes (NABH-OPD mandatory items).
metrics.label: Documentation completeness

metrics.definition: Non-informational, non-underuse findings with verdict low-value per 100 canonical notes; also the share of notes with at least one.
metrics.label: Low-value findings per 100 notes

caveats: Complexity-adjusted only; age band is not available.
metrics.definition: Notes with a low-value finding (O) over the sum of complexity-band stratum rates (E). Unbanded notes excluded. Not age-adjusted (age is not stored).
metrics.label: Low-value care observed/expected

caveats: Class membership is the audit's rule text; completeness UNVERIFIED.
metrics.definition: Duplicate-prescription / duplicate-molecule / therapeutic-duplication findings per 1,000 prescriptions (with a medication line) among the audited notes found in the DB13 extract.
metrics.label: Same-class duplicates per 1,000 Rx

metrics.definition: Patient age is not stored on the audit row and the engine has no Beers/sedative-60+ rule.
metrics.label: Sedatives in age 60+ per 1,000 Rx

metrics.definition: Neither age nor a CKD flag is stored.
metrics.label: NSAID in age 60+ or CKD per 1,000 Rx

metrics.definition: Only the NSAID + ACE-I/ARB pair rule exists; there is no three-drug (with diuretic) test.
metrics.label: Triple whammy per 1,000 Rx

caveats: Text match on the finding rationale; no structured rule id is stored. Low-dose aspirin may be counted in both classes (UNVERIFIED).
metrics.definition: drug_interaction findings whose rationale names an NSAID and an anticoagulant/antiplatelet, per 1,000 prescriptions.
metrics.label: NSAID with an antithrombotic per 1,000 Rx

metrics.definition: Share of prescriptions (with a medication line) listing five or more medicines, from the DB13 extract.
metrics.label: Prescriptions with 5 or more medicines

caveats: Shape of further_investigation in the extract is UNVERIFIED; a non-array counts as 0 tests.
metrics.definition: Investigation lines per audited consult found in the DB13 extract (further_investigation array length).
metrics.label: Tests per consult

metrics.definition: No WHO AWaRe classification is available: the formulary marks Reserve (restricted) only, and no AWaRe list is in the repo or the DB13 extract.
metrics.label: WHO Access share of antibiotics

metrics.definition: No WHO AWaRe classification is available: the formulary marks Reserve (restricted) only, and no AWaRe list is in the repo or the DB13 extract.
metrics.label: Prescriptions with a Watch agent

caveats: A lower bound: only what the audit caught. ICD code set UNVERIFIED.
metrics.definition: Audited URTI consults (ICD J00-J06, J20-J22 in the DB13 extract) carrying the ratified R5 finding 'antibiotic for acute upper-respiratory illness', as a share of audited URTI consults.
metrics.label: Antibiotic flagged in viral URTI

metrics.definition: No ratified gastroenteritis-antibiotic rule exists, so there is no numerator.
metrics.label: Antibiotics in gastroenteritis

metrics.definition: No order/MAR timestamps are in the DB13 extract and no rule exists.
metrics.label: Post-operative prophylaxis longer than 24 h
